title: Main LV switchgear current rating
text: The main LV switchgear (SWG-01) shall have a rated busbar current of not less than 4000 A.

title: UPS rated capacity
text: Each UPS module (UPS-02) shall have a rated output of not less than 500 kW.

title: UPS battery runtime
text: The UPS battery system (BAT-02) shall support the full rated load for not less than 10 minutes.

title: UPS efficiency
text: UPS-02 shall achieve an efficiency of not less than 96 % in double-conversion mode at full load.

title: Generator standby rating
text: The standby diesel generator (GEN-01) shall have a standby rating of not less than 1500 kW.

title: Generator start time
text: GEN-01 shall start and accept load within not more than 15 seconds of a utility failure signal.

title: Generator fuel storage
text: On-site fuel storage for GEN-01 shall support not less than 48 hours of operation at full load.

title: ATS transfer time
text: The automatic transfer switch (ATS-01) shall complete a transfer within not more than 10 seconds.

title: ATS current rating
text: ATS-01 shall be rated for not less than 2000 A continuous current.

title: Feeder breaker rating
text: The main feeder circuit breaker (BRK-05) shall have a rated current of exactly 630 A.

title: Breaker breaking capacity
text: BRK-05 shall have a short-circuit breaking capacity of not less than 50 kA.

title: PDU output voltage
text: The power distribution unit (PDU-01) shall deliver an output voltage of 415 V.

title: Concurrent maintainability
text: Each critical load shall be fed through not fewer than 2 independent power paths, so that any one path can be isolated for maintenance without load interruption (PDU-01).

title: Power fault tolerance
text: The power distribution (PDU-01) shall tolerate not fewer than 1 simultaneous fault without interrupting any critical load.

title: Chiller cooling capacity
text: The water-cooled chiller (CHL-01) shall have a cooling capacity of not less than 1200 kW.

title: Chiller efficiency
text: CHL-01 shall achieve a coefficient of performance (COP) of not less than 5.5 at full load.

title: Chilled water supply temperature
text: CHL-01 shall deliver chilled water at a supply temperature of 18 degC.

title: Chilled water pump flow
text: The chilled water pump (PMP-01) shall deliver a flow of not less than 36 L/s.

title: Chilled water pump head
text: PMP-01 shall provide a rated head of not less than 30 m.

title: Cooling tower heat rejection
text: The cooling tower (CT-01) shall have a heat rejection capacity of not less than 1500 kW.

title: CRAH cooling capacity
text: Each CRAH unit (CRAH-01) shall have a cooling capacity of not less than 100 kW.

title: CRAH supply air temperature
text: CRAH-01 shall deliver supply air at a temperature of not more than 25 degC.

title: Cooling redundancy (N+1)
text: The cooling plant shall include not fewer than 1 standby chiller, so that full capacity is maintained when any one chiller is out of service (CHL-01).

title: Cooling restart after transfer
text: After a transfer to generator power, CHL-01 shall resume cooling within not more than 120 seconds.

title: Cooling fault tolerance
text: A single failure in the cooling path shall not reduce available cooling capacity below 100 % of the design load (CHL-01).
